Ravi: I can steward the cache bundle (RW-7010 + RW-7011). i'll add acceptance criteria and a rollback plan.

Nadia: I'll take RW-7012 and coordinate infra review. tagging @Support-Triage for RW-7013 triage.

Support-Triage: RW-7013 assigned to Support-Triage for initial investigation.

ops-bot: Parent ticket RW-7100 created: postmortem-remediation-cohort-A. Checkpoint scheduled in 96h.
